description: This Java interface defines the contract for services related to writing and managing savings account operations, such as activation, deposits, withdrawals, transfers, charges, and account status updates within the Fineract system.

classes.name: SavingsAccountWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for savings account write operations in the Fineract system.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a savings account based on the provided command.

methods.name: deposit
methods.description: Handles deposit transactions on a savings account.

methods.name: withdrawal
methods.description: Handles withdrawal transactions from a savings account.

methods.name: applyAnnualFee
methods.description: Applies an annual fee to a savings account.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest for a savings account.

methods.name: reverseTransaction
methods.description: Reverses a transaction on a savings account, with allowance for account transfer modification.

methods.name: undoTransaction
methods.description: Undoes a specific transaction.

methods.name: adjustSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Adjusts a savings transaction, possibly for corrections or modifications.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the savings account.

methods.name: initiateSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer of savings to another account.

methods.name: withdrawSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Completes a transfer that was initiated.

methods.name: rejectSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Rejects a savings transfer request.

methods.name: acceptSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Accepts and processes a savings transfer.

methods.name: addSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Adds a charge to the savings account.

methods.name: updateSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Updates an existing charge on a savings account.

methods.name: deleteSavingsAccountCharge
methods.description: Deletes a specific savings account charge.

methods.name: waiveCharge
methods.description: Waives a charge on the account.

methods.name: payCharge
methods.description: Pays a specified charge.

methods.name: inactivateCharge
methods.description: Inactivates a charge.

methods.name: assignFieldOfficer
methods.description: Assigns a field officer to the account.

methods.name: unassignFieldOfficer
methods.description: Removes assigned field officer.

methods.name: applyChargeDue
methods.description: Applies due charges to the account.

methods.name: processPostActiveActions
methods.description: Processes actions after account activation, handling transactions and status updates.

methods.name: modifyWithHoldTax
methods.description: Modifies withholding tax details on the account.

methods.name: setSubStatusInactive
methods.description: Sets account sub-status to inactive.

methods.name: setSubStatusDormant
methods.description: Sets account sub-status to dormant.

methods.name: escheat
methods.description: Performs escheatment, transferring funds to the state after dormancy.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Posts accrued interest to the account.

methods.name: blockAccount
methods.description: Blocks the account from transactions.

methods.name: unblockAccount
methods.description: Unblocks the account.

methods.name: holdAmount
methods.description: Holds a specified amount on the account.

methods.name: blockCredits
methods.description: Blocks credit transactions.

methods.name: unblockCredits
methods.description: Unblocks credit transactions.

methods.name: blockDebits
methods.description: Blocks debit transactions.

methods.name: unblockDebits
methods.description: Unblocks debit transactions.

methods.name: releaseAmount
methods.description: Releases a held amount.

methods.name: gsimActivate
methods.description: Activates a GSIM related operation.

methods.name: gsimDeposit
methods.description: Processes a deposit in a GSIM context.

methods.name: bulkGSIMClose
methods.description: Closes multiple GSIM accounts in bulk.
